scientific_integrity: A self-contained proof and standard-library finite verifier are included; finite tests do not certify infinite claims; the 2020 normalized inverse-distance tree theorem is explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Exact integer positive scores and labeled path graphs only. Disconnected induced coalitions are inadmissible; ambient-graph distances and branching networks are not covered. No independent external audit or absolute publication-priority guarantee.
title: Welfare-maximal coalitions on paths: Nash rigidity and a partition-count phase transition
